turns.text: Thank you for calling {{brand}} support, this is {{agent_name}}. Could I take your full name please?
Yes, it's {{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
Thank you. And the mobile number registered on the account?
It is {{PHONE}}.
Perfect, I can see the account now. Is there an email I should send the confirmation to?
You can use {{EMAIL}}.
Good afternoon, {{brand}} customer care. May I know who I'm speaking with?
This is {{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}} calling about my account.
Sure. For verification, can you confirm your registered mobile number?
Sure, {{PHONE}}.
That matches. How can I help you today?
I wanted to check why my last payment did not go through.
Welcome to {{brand}}. Before we proceed I'll need to verify a few details. Your name?
{{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
And an email address on file?
That would be {{EMAIL}}.
Thank you, verification complete.
Hello, this is {{agent_name}} from {{brand}} calling regarding your pending KYC update.
Oh yes, I've been meaning to finish that.
Could you confirm your full name as it appears on the document?
It's {{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
And your Aadhaar number please?
It's {{AADHAAR}}.
Noted. I'll also need your PAN.
{{brand}} compliance team here. We need to re-verify your identity documents.
Alright, what do you need?
Your Aadhaar number to begin with.
It is {{AADHAAR}}.
Thank you {{GIVEN_NAME}}, that's verified.
I'll need your PAN card details to update the tax records.
The PAN is {{PAN}}, and the name on it is {{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
Got it. And is the Aadhaar linked to this PAN the same one ending in the usual digits?
Yes, {{AADHAAR}}.
Hi, I'm calling from {{brand}} about your delivery scheduled for tomorrow.
Yes, I was expecting a call.
Could you confirm the delivery address?
It's {{ADDRESS}}, {{LANDMARK}}.
And a number the delivery partner can reach you on?
{{PHONE}}.
Our delivery partner couldn't locate the address. Could you give me directions?
Sure. The address is {{ADDRESS}}. Tell him it's {{LANDMARK}}.
Understood, I'll pass that along. And the name for the package?
{{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
Good morning, {{brand}} logistics. Am I speaking to {{GIVEN_NAME}}?
Speaking.
We have a package for {{ADDRESS}}. Is someone available there today?
Yes, but the gate is hard to find. It's {{LANDMARK}}.
Noted. Best number to call on arrival?
{{PHONE}}.
{{brand}} fraud desk, this is {{agent_name}}. We've flagged a transaction on your card.
I was worried about that. My name is {{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
For security, could you confirm the PAN linked to this account?
It's {{PAN}}.
Thank you. I'm blocking the card now and a replacement will be sent.
Thank you for holding. Could I have the registered mobile number to pull up your file?
It's {{PHONE}}, under the name {{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
I see it. What seems to be the problem?
The net banking login keeps failing after I enter the OTP.
I can raise a dispute for you. First, your full name?
{{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
And where should I send the dispute reference number?
Email it to {{EMAIL}} please.
Done. You should receive it within the hour.
I'm afraid the specialist team is closed now. Can I arrange a callback?
Yes please. The number is {{PHONE}}.
And who should they ask for?
{{GIVEN_NAME}}.
They'll call between ten and twelve tomorrow.
Sorry about the wait. Would you prefer I email you the details instead?
Email is fine, it's {{EMAIL}}.
And a contact number as backup?
{{PHONE}}.
{{brand}} claims department. Could I start with the policy holder's name?
{{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
And the Aadhaar number for the claim form?
It's {{AADHAAR}}.
Where should the surveyor visit?
{{ADDRESS}}, {{LANDMARK}}.
To process the claim I need to confirm a few things. Your registered address?
{{ADDRESS}} in {{city}}.
Is there a landmark? Our surveyors sometimes struggle.
Yes, {{LANDMARK}}.
Thank you {{GIVEN_NAME}}, I've noted that.
{{brand}} here. You'd requested a SIM replacement, is that right?
Yes, I lost my phone yesterday.
I'll need the Aadhaar number used at the time of activation.
It's {{AADHAAR}}.
And the number to be replaced?
{{PHONE}}.
The new SIM will be delivered to your registered address.
Your broadband installation is scheduled. Confirming the address: could you read it out?
{{ADDRESS}}, {{LANDMARK}}.
And the account is under which name?
{{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
The technician will call you on arrival.
I can port your number today. What is the number you wish to port?
{{PHONE}}.
And for identity verification, your PAN?
Thank you, the porting request is raised.
I see an order under your account. Could you confirm the name on it?
{{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
And the shipping address?
{{ADDRESS}}.
I'll process the return and refund to the original method.
Which email is the order placed under?
{{EMAIL}}.
Found it. And should I send the replacement to the same address?
Yes, {{ADDRESS}}, {{LANDMARK}}.
Hello {{GIVEN_NAME}}, I'm calling about the refund you raised.
Yes, it's been two weeks now.
I apologise. Could you confirm the mobile number on the account?
{{PHONE}}.
The refund has been re-initiated, you'll get a confirmation email.
{{brand}} billing. Could I have the consumer name on the connection?
{{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
And the service address?
{{ADDRESS}}, {{LANDMARK}}, {{city}}.
Your bill has been corrected, apologies for the error.
We have a meter reading discrepancy at the property. Who am I speaking to?
{{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}, I'm the owner.
Could you share a contact number for the meter reader?
{{PHONE}}.
Someone will visit this week.
I can book that appointment. Name please?
{{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
Contact number?
{{PHONE}}.
And email for the reminder?
{{EMAIL}}.
You're confirmed for Thursday at four.
Can I get an address so the technician knows where to come?
{{ADDRESS}}. It's a bit tricky, {{LANDMARK}}.
Noted, and your name for the job card?
{{GIVEN_NAME}}.
Haan sir, bataiye, how can I help you today?
Mera naam {{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}} hai, and my number is {{PHONE}}.
Ji, ek minute. Aapka account mil gaya.
Theek hai. Email bhi update kar dijiye, it's {{EMAIL}}.
Address confirm kar dijiye please, for the delivery.
Haan, {{ADDRESS}} hai, aur {{LANDMARK}}.
Perfect, delivery kal ho jayegi.
Thank you for calling. How may I assist you today?
I just wanted to understand the difference between the two plans you advertise.
Certainly. The basic plan includes unlimited calls and five gigabytes of data, while the premium adds international roaming.
And is there a contract period for either of them?
The basic is month to month. The premium requires a twelve month commitment.
That's helpful, thank you. I'll think about it and call back.
Good evening, how can I help?
My internet has been very slow since this morning. Is there an outage in the area?
Let me check. Yes, there is scheduled maintenance in your region until about six o'clock.
Alright, I'll wait then. Thanks for confirming.
Your account will be frozen unless the KYC is completed this week.
I understand. My Aadhaar is {{AADHAAR}}.
Thank you. And the PAN associated with it?
Both are now on file, {{GIVEN_NAME}}.
I can complete the verification over the call if you have the documents handy.
Yes I do. Aadhaar first? It's {{AADHAAR}}.
Thank you. Could you also read out the PAN?
Sure, {{PAN}}.
And an email to send the acknowledgement?
{{EMAIL}}.
For the filing I'll need the PAN exactly as printed.
It's {{PAN}}, in the name of {{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
And the Aadhaar for linking?
{{AADHAAR}}.
The return will be filed by Friday.
Has your PAN been linked with Aadhaar already?
I'm not sure. The PAN is {{PAN}}.
Let me check. Could you read the Aadhaar as well?
{{AADHAAR}}.
They are linked. Nothing further is needed.
The subsidy application needs your Aadhaar for the direct transfer.
It is {{AADHAAR}}.
And confirming the beneficiary name?
{{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
The amount will be credited within ten working days.
To reset the password I'll send a link to the registered email.
That's {{EMAIL}}, I think.
That matches. And a backup email in case this one is inaccessible?
You could use {{EMAIL}} as well, actually just the first one is fine.
Understood, the link is on its way.
The account is locked after too many attempts. Could I have the email on it?
{{EMAIL}}.
And the mobile number to send the OTP?
{{PHONE}}.
Please read back the code once you receive it.
I can add you to the priority support list. Which email should I use?
Use {{EMAIL}} please, and the name is {{GIVEN_NAME}} {{SURNAME}}.
Added. You'll get a confirmation shortly.
